Number Of Engines.note: An EGLE public notice for permit application APP-2023-0209, saved on the Wayback Machine in May 2024 (https://web.archive.org/web/20240502121707id_/https://www.egle.state.mi.us/aps/downloads/permits/PubNotice/APP-2023-0209/APP-2023-0209NOH.pdf), lists six natural gas-fired reciprocating engines, each rated at 29,147 horsepower. A WKAR article from July 2024 (https://www.wkar.org/wkar-news/2024-07-01/bwl-receives-green-light-to-build-natural-gas-fired-plant) says the same. This is a saved copy of the notice.

units.notes: The engine plant is probably not yet operating. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) has no engine generators at Delta Energy Park, only the four combined cycle and turbine generators. A Lansing Board of Water and Light page (https://lbwl.com/cleanenergyprojects) lists 110 MW of flexible generation at Delta Energy Park as part of work shown completed in 2027. WKAR reported in July 2024 (https://www.wkar.org/wkar-news/2024-07-01/bwl-receives-green-light-to-build-natural-gas-fired-plant) that BWL expects the plant to be operational by the end of 2026. I found no public report that the engines are running, so I did not change the status and raised a question.

qa.recommendation: The engine plant may still be in construction or commissioning, not operating. Please confirm with Lansing Board of Water and Light before the status stays operating.
